events.text: World: Vale stands alone in Mirror attic, holding an unlit lamp. A tall mirror reflects a black shore.
World: Vale lights the Lamp.
World: The attic mirror and the pond open onto each other. A dark shore waits between them.
World: Vale goes to Black pond through the reflection. Something on the far shore turns its head.
World: Vale covers the Lamp with the Black cloth.
World: Pip asks Vale for the Lamp. Vale keeps it for now.
World: The pond's reflected path to the attic closes. The shore path to the station remains open.
World: Vale uncovers and takes the Black cloth.
World: The pond's reflection opens a path to the attic.
